[p1 | acting_agent | action_plan]
RESET (green was placed in wrong slot, consumed). Then place to match top ref order L->R blue,green,yellow,purple: select blue->S1, select green->S2. Will fill yellow->S3, purple->S4 next call.

[p2 | acting_agent | action_plan]
S1=blue,S2=green done. Complete top-ref order: select yellow->S3, select purple->S4, yielding blue,green,yellow,purple to win.

round=1 engine=0 accuracy=100.0

Complete snake order lower row R->L: blue->l40, yellow->l28, pink->l22 (green->l34 already confirmed by connector), then ACTION5 submit to win L2.

[p7 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Boustrophedon failed; reset and apply ZIP mapping (synth _board_matches). Place top row first: orange->u22, purple->u28, red->u40; bottom row blue/green/yellow/pink next call then ACTION5.

ZIP mapping: top=orange,purple,red already placed; fill lower L->R blue->l22, green->l28, yellow->l34, pink->l40, then ACTION5 submit to win L2.

[p9 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L2 nesting hypothesis: lower box plugs into green-ring slot; reset and place u22=orange,u28=purple,u40=pink,l22=red,l28=blue,l34=green,l40=yellow then submit.

Now place 6 solids into sub-box empties: BLUE box(row36) empties (18,36)&(24,36)=yellow tiles from tray x3,x24; ORANGE box(row36) empties (44,36)&(50,36)=purple x17,x38; GREEN box(row22) empties (44,22)&(50,22)=pink x10,x31. Traversal spells refs [blue,yellow,yellow, orange,purple,purple, green,pink,pink]. Then ACTION5 to submit.

[p16 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L7 U-path hypothesis: fill left+right columns of the 3 boxes with the 6 solid tiles (orange.25/37, blue.25/37, green.25/37) so the traversal reads the palindrome. Rings into mid slots + ACTION5 next call.

[s17 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=18 engine=16 accuracy=100.0

[p17 | acting_agent | action_plan]
6 solids placed correctly. Now drop blue ring into blue.mid(31,29) and green ring into orange.mid(31,16) to fill the 2 leftover slots, then ACTION5. U-path traversal (left col down, yellow, right col up) should equal palindrome refs and win.

[p18 | acting_agent | action_plan]
RESET then place 6 solids on left/right of each box (red.25/37, blue.25/37, green.25/37). Next call: BLUE ring->red.31, GREEN ring->blue.31 (nested splice; rings were color-swapped before), then ACTION5.

[p19 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Nested splice: BLUE ring into red.31 (splices blue box), GREEN ring into blue.31 (splices green box). Traversal 8,(9,(14,11,14),9),8 == palindrome refs. ACTION5 to submit.

[p20 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L8 cycle-splice probe: fill RED root box [red8,yellow11,purple12,blueRing] then start BLUE box with blue9; cross-rings form a red<->blue cycle whose read repeats the 6-period to match all 12 refs.

[s18 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=19 engine=17 accuracy=100.0

[p21 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Finish L8 BLUE box [9,14,15,redRing]: place green14->slot28, pink15->slot34, redRing->slot40, then ACTION5. Completes the red<->blue cross-ring cycle whose traversal repeats 8,11,12,9,14,15 twice == 12 refs. Submit to observe reward and confirm cycle-splice mechanic.
